hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/grayson-highlands (Site types: 'Electric/Water sites; 20, 30 and 50-amp; various equipment. Up to 40 feet'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Hickory Ridge Campground: 38 electric/water sites up to 40 ft and 28 no-hookup sites up to 30 ft, plus 4 yurts, a bunkhouse and a tent group site. The separate Chestnut Hollow equestrian campground (24 horse sites) is for campers with horses and books by phone only.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/grayson-highlands (Total sites of each type; Site types), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/grayson-highlands (bathhouses with showers in the campground loops; amenities list incl. Dump Station, Showers, Camp Store/Gift Shop; the Country Store beside the campground; 'LAUNDRY None.'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Hickory Ridge sites are reserved by site number, online or at 1-800-933-PARK; 'reservations are strongly recommended'. Chestnut Hollow (equestrian) books by phone only, open to non-equestrians from 30 days before arrival.

The park's page: 'full-service camping is only available from May through October.' Primitive camping is allowed only at Chestnut Hollow, the horse campground, in March, April and November; no camping from the first Monday in December to the first Friday in March.

summary: Added 50-amp electric + water (38 E/W sites to 40 ft, 28 no-hookup to 30 ft), 66 sites, showers, dump, camp store, no laundry, reservable by site. Season NOT changed (manual, from DCR's statewide camping page) though the park page narrows it: see flag. Not stated: sewer, booking window/cutoff, fcfs, max stay; fees already from DCR's table. Season narrowed to May-October from the park's own page (the earlier 03-01/12-07 came from DCR's statewide page).
